about.h2: Two apartments, two addresses, one quiet village by the sea.
about.imgAlt: Petrčane from the air — a turquoise bay with a marina, the village, vineyards and Velebit in the background
about.lead: Mare and Gumbek are two independent apartments in Petrčane, a quiet village on the Zadar riviera — each at its own address. Each has its own entrance, kitchen, air conditioning, free parking space and outdoor space: Mare a garden and a large covered terrace, Gumbek a balcony and two floors.
about.p2: Mare is a ground-floor apartment with no stairs, a garden and a terrace where summer life really happens — a good choice for families with small children. Gumbek is spread over two floors, with the sleeping area upstairs and two bathrooms, so it suits couples, friends or a family that likes a little more room. No reception, no corridors — the whole apartment is yours.
about.p3: Travelling with more than one family? You can book both — they are in the same village, and for a joint enquiry we send one offer. Both are equipped for a real holiday: dishwasher, hob, coffee machine, TV, fast Wi-Fi and a free parking space.

ac.d: In both apartments, so even an August afternoon passes in the cool.

beach.d: From either apartment it is about a ten-minute walk to Donje Petrčane beach; Punta Radman beach is even closer to Mare.

kitchen.d: Oven, hob, dishwasher, microwave, coffee machine and enough crockery for the whole party.

outdoor.d: Mare has a garden and a covered terrace with an outdoor kitchen, Gumbek a balcony with an awning.

parking.d: A free private parking space at each apartment — no driving around looking for one.

wifi.d: In both apartments, with no data limit — enough for working remotely too.

mare.desc: A ground-floor apartment with its own garden and a covered terrace that is really a second living room — it has an outdoor kitchen with a sink, a stone fireplace for grilling and a table for six. Inside there is a bright dining room, a living room and a bedroom, all level with the courtyard, without a single step.
